_status: INACTIVE SYNTHETIC TEMPLATE. No authorization or prior execution is transferred. Configure recipient resources and obtain explicit authority before live use.
purpose: Inspect a hypothetical preview/read-back discrepancy using a recipient-approved isolated fixture. This template is inactive.

target.name: Seren Harness Test
target.config: ~/seren-harness-live/config.json (private; existing Seren CLI OAuth session by reference)

baseline.last_observed: Inactive synthetic handover example. Recipient must establish a fresh baseline and authorization.

correction.use: previewed only, using the frozen example input, as one --prompt=<contents> argument; never sent as an update

sequence: agent managed-preview 7a00003a-… --prompt=<exact contents of SKILL.corrected.md> -o json

limits.basis: Each step runs at most once through the SerenCli wrapper with the pinned 60 s timeout (the CLI process is killed and reaped on expiry). By the pinned v0.10.0 source, managed-preview is one direct POST, not a managed mutation, so the CLI's same-request-id re-send does not apply; each read is one GET. Wall bound assumes 60 s plus about 2 s local overhead per invocation. One command invocation is authorized; a re-invocation would only resume (never repeat a step).

side_effects: The preview's server-side effects are uncertain and not assumed absent. The post-preview reads record what is observed; a change is reported, not attributed or repaired.
excluded: No managed-update, provisioning, Passwords setup or apply, start, stop, Discord request, probe, model session or instruction-update. The command has no route to any of them.

evidence.kept: binding digests (config, package, instruction files, CLI executable and version); per step: purpose, command name, times, status class and exit code; structural observations of config, secret_keys, guarded and policy fields, bundle, changed_fields and pre/post state
evidence.never_kept: raw responses, values, unlisted key names, labels, condition messages, stderr, secret values, or any hash of response content

stop_conditions: local pins, CLI checksum or version differ: refused before any call
a recorded journal whose inputs differ: refused before any call, journal untouched
prerequisite reads do not show the recorded deployment, identity, revision 7a00002b, original instruction and stopped/stopped: stop before the preview
after the preview is attempted (answered, failed, timed out or malformed): only the two post-preview reads, then stop
an interruption before the preview: no preview on re-invocation; after the preview: only the post-preview reads not yet started
acceptance: Either result=complete with structural observations of config and secret_keys in the pre-preview read, preview current, preview proposed and post-preview read, plus the post-preview state; or an explicit stopped/incomplete result that lists each unavailable observation.
